logs.message: Assign the account to the owning program

name: dbc_launch
why: a Meteora DBC launch: EvtInitializePool names the partner CONFIG, which is how bags.fm and the other front ends are attributed without ever becoming venues

logs.message: Warning: Mint has a permanent delegate, so tokens in this account may be seized at any time

name: launchlab_launch
why: a Raydium LaunchLab launch. PoolCreateEvent names NEITHER mint, so they come from account metas and are proved against the pool's own PDA seeds

name: pumpfun_create
why: a pump.fun LAUNCH: three Borsh Strings at the front of CreateEvent, so nothing in it is at a fixed offset, and a bonding curve that must re-derive as the program's own PDA of the mint

name: pumpfun_graduation
why: the curve moving into PumpSwap. Its CompletePumpAmmMigrationEvent NAMES the destination pool, which is the join key that makes a token's chart continue after the curve is gone - the whole point of the module

logs.message: commission_rate: 0, platform_fee_rate: 0, trim_rate: 0, commission_direction: false, acc_close_flag: false

name: pumpfun_multi_buy
why: ONE transaction holding SEVERAL pump.fun curve trades - the bundle a sniper sends. Each must stay its own row: a decoder reading transaction level balances would report one netted trade

name: pumpfun_quote_curve
why: a pump.fun curve quoted in something other than SOL. sol_amount is 0 and the real leg is in the TradeEvent tail, behind a Borsh String and a Vec - the case that cost 1.8-11.5% of curve trades
